templates.name: Free
templates.description: Every agent on a free OpenCode Zen model. Muse Spark thinks, Nemotron Ultra builds, Ling reads. One key, and two fallbacks each.

templates.name: Free (OpenRouter)
templates.description: The same on OpenRouter's free tier. Inkling thinks and is the one free model here with every effort, MiniMax M3 builds, Ling reads.

templates.name: Budget
templates.description: The cheapest set on OpenRouter that still finishes a task. Ling reads at $0.021/M, DeepSeek Flash builds at $0.065, GLM 5.3 Flash thinks at $0.075.

templates.name: Gemini API
templates.description: Every agent on Google. Gemini 3.1 Pro plans and reasons, Flash reads the codebase and the docs, Flash-Lite handles the throwaway work.

templates.name: GPT API
templates.description: Every agent on OpenAI. GPT-5.6 takes the hard calls, Sol runs autonomously, Terra builds, Luna reads.

templates.name: Claude API
templates.description: Every agent on Anthropic. Opus 5 does the thinking, Sonnet 5 does the building, Haiku 4.5 does the reading, Fable 5 does the prose.

templates.name: oh-my-openagent recommended
templates.description: The line-up oh-my-openagent publishes for itself: Opus 5 orchestrates, Fable plans, GPT-5.6 reviews, and the cheap models do the looking. Sisyphus-Junior is left to category routing, as its author intends.

source.name: oh-my-openagent
source.note: Per-agent and per-category models as published on omo.dev, resolved to ids this opencode can reach.

templates.name: Daily work
templates.description: Opus 5 as the brain with Gemini underneath every agent, so a rate limit at Anthropic slows you down instead of stopping you.
